---
title: "Explore Metadata"
---

Below is an interactive table of the dataset metadata. Use the dropdowns to filter;
use the search box to find specific terms; click a column header to sort.

<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom:10px;">
  <div>
    <label for="filter-view" style="font-size:12px;">View</label><br/>
    <select id="filter-view">
      <option value="">(all)</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="filter-scene" style="font-size:12px;">Scene</label><br/>
    <select id="filter-scene">
      <option value="">(all)</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="filter-location" style="font-size:12px;">Location</label><br/>
    <select id="filter-location">
      <option value="">(all)</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-left:auto;">
    <button id="download-filtered" style="padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:6px; background:white; cursor:pointer;">
      ⬇️ Download filtered CSV
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<div style="font-size:12px; color:#555; margin-bottom:6px;">
  <span id="count-text">Loading...</span>
</div>

<table id="meta" class="display" style="width:100%"></table>

<!-- Dependencies (CDN) -->
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.8/css/jquery.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.8/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/papaparse@5.5.2/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<script>
(async function() {
  // 1) Load CSV with PapaParse (handles commas/quotes safely)
  const csvUrl = "data/metadata.csv";
  const text = await fetch(csvUrl).then(r => r.text());
  const parsed = Papa.parse(text, { header: true, dynamicTyping: false, skipEmptyLines: true });

  const rows = parsed.data;
  if (!rows.length) {
    document.getElementById('count-text').textContent = "No rows found.";
    return;
  }

  // 2) Decide which columns to show (reorder/add/remove as you prefer)
  const wantedCols = [
    "filename", "date", "time", "location", "view", "scene",
    "latitude", "longitude", "iso", "ev"
  ].filter(c => parsed.meta.fields.includes(c)); // keep only those that actually exist

  // 3) Build DataTables column defs
  const columns = wantedCols.map(c => ({ title: c, data: c }));

  // 4) Initialize DataTable
  const table = $('#meta').DataTable({
    data: rows,
    columns: columns,
    pageLength: 25,
    deferRender: true,
    order: [], // no default ordering
    dom: 'lftrip', // controls layout (length, filter, table, info, paging)
  });

  // helper: get unique sorted values from a column
  function uniqueValues(colName) {
    const s = new Set();
    rows.forEach(r => { if (r[colName] !== undefined && r[colName] !== "") s.add(r[colName]); });
    return Array.from(s).sort((a,b) => (a+"").localeCompare(b+""));
  }

  // 5) Populate dropdowns
  function populateSelect(id, values) {
    const sel = document.getElementById(id);
    values.forEach(v => {
      const opt = document.createElement('option');
      opt.value = v; opt.textContent = v;
      sel.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }
  if (parsed.meta.fields.includes("view"))     populateSelect("filter-view", uniqueValues("view"));
  if (parsed.meta.fields.includes("scene"))    populateSelect("filter-scene", uniqueValues("scene"));
  if (parsed.meta.fields.includes("location")) populateSelect("filter-location", uniqueValues("location"));

  // 6) Filtering: apply DataTables column search on change
  const colIndex = Object.fromEntries(wantedCols.map((c,i)=>[c,i]));

  function applyFilters() {
    const view = $('#filter-view').val() || '';
    const scene = $('#filter-scene').val() || '';
    const loc = $('#filter-location').val() || '';

    // Clear previous
    table.columns().search('');

    if (view && colIndex.view !== undefined)       table.column(colIndex.view).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(view) + '$', true, false);
    if (scene && colIndex.scene !== undefined)     table.column(colIndex.scene).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(scene) + '$', true, false);
    if (loc && colIndex.location !== undefined)    table.column(colIndex.location).search('^' + $.fn.dataTable.util.escapeRegex(loc) + '$', true, false);

    table.draw();
    updateCounts();
  }

  $('#filter-view, #filter-scene, #filter-location').on('change', applyFilters);

  // 7) Counts text (filtered vs total)
  function updateCounts() {
    const filtered = table.rows({ filter: 'applied' }).count();
    const total = table.rows().count();
    document.getElementById('count-text').textContent = `${filtered} row(s) shown of ${total}`;
  }
  table.on('draw', updateCounts);
  updateCounts();

  // 8) Download filtered CSV
  document.getElementById('download-filtered').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const data = table.rows({ filter: 'applied' }).data().toArray();
    if (!data.length) return;

    const csv = Papa.unparse(data, { columns: wantedCols });
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url; a.download = 'SCENES_metadata_filtered.csv';
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  });

})();
</script>
